lemma_statement: theorem theta_mem_Iw (u : U) : θG u ∈ Iw p 1
b2_reason: As elaborated, the statement omitted the section hypothesis hU : (U : Set G) ⊆ levelM1 θG (used only in the proof, so Lean did not auto-include it); without it the conclusion is false for an arbitrary subgroup U. REPAIRED IN PLACE by `include hU in` (restores the intended section context; no call site changes). Logged so a decompose pass does not re-ticket the hU-free form.
counterexample: U = ⊤ with θG mapping some u to a matrix with a non-integral entry: θG u ∉ Iw p 1.
